name: Example: Spirit Walker Whirling Slash / Twister — two weapon sets, two jobs
notes: The classic community weapon-set pattern. Weapon set 1 carries a FAST spear (Winged Spear, 1.7 aps) for Whirling Slash — the gem stays low level because it's the generator/mobility button; its set-tagged nodes buy ATTACK SPEED, which the fast spear multiplies. Weapon set 2 carries a SLOW, high-damage crit spear (Runemastered Ironhead) with a high-level Twister; its set-tagged nodes buy DAMAGE and CRIT — speed would be wasted on a 1.25 aps weapon. The game swaps tree and skill together with the weapons: each mode is fully specialized without paying twice from the 99 main points.
